expectations.text: Skill opens with grounding/broad clarifying questions rather than jumping straight to a SPECS.md draft on the first turn
expectations.evidence: Executor report: round 1 was pure grounding (who submits/receives, current process, pain point) before touching inputs/outputs/format, appropriately starting vague and sharpening by round 3.

expectations.text: Exactly one SPECS.md and one RUBRIC.md were produced by the end (no side-by-side alternates)
expectations.evidence: Only SPECS.md and RUBRIC.md exist; a genuine individual-vs-bulk-reconciliation fork was resolved via a question, not split into two documents.

expectations.text: Final SPECS.md is concrete and specific to whatever expense-report scenario emerged from questioning, not generic/hand-wavy
expectations.evidence: Grounded in specific policy numbers ($25/$75/$100 limits) and a fixed six-column template.

expectations.text: SPECS.md contains all required sections (Purpose, Trigger conditions, Inputs, Outputs, Scope & boundaries, Non-goals, Edge cases, Open assumptions)
expectations.evidence: Executor report confirms all eight required sections present.

expectations.text: Every RUBRIC.md criterion has a 0-3 scale with concrete, spec-grounded per-level descriptions; 6-12 criteria plus a correctly-computed scoring summary table
expectations.evidence: 11 criteria, each with a 0/1/2/3 breakdown grounded in specific policy numbers and rules; scoring table max is 33, bands (30-33/21-29/15-20/14-or-below) correctly correspond to ~90%/65%/45% of 33.

expectations.text: No SKILL.md-style content appears anywhere in the output
expectations.evidence: grep found no frontmatter or skill-drafting content.
